backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining user profiles, waste classification logic, daily challenge tracking, and access‑controlled state storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two author‑attribution features to their related frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing each frontend source file’s purpose and functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base definitions and OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes across the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file including metadata, author tag (WAMIQ AHMAD), icons, and root app mount.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing basic install, fetch cache fallback, and old‑cache cleanup.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router setup with hash history, theme provider, and all app routes.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: App layout wrapper with header, offline and sync‑error banners, service worker registration, and bottom navigation.
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: Authentication button handling Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Bottom navigation bar linking to primary routes with icons and active‑state styling.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Displays a dialog for new authenticated users to set a display name and saves the profile via backend mutation.
frontend/src/components/scan/CameraGuida: Renders an on-screen camera framing guide and tips to help users take better scan photos.
frontend/src/components/scan/ScanConfirm: Shows an image preview, optional description input, and confirm/discard actions before processing a scan.
frontend/src/components/scan/scanTypes.t: Defines scan state types and provides helper labels for confirm/discard actions based on the scan source.
frontend/src/components/States.tsx: Provides reusable loading, empty, and error UI state components with optional actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and maintains a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state, login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useOfflineSync.ts: Syncs queued offline scan events when the user is online and authenticated, with retry and status handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend queries and mutations for user profiles, scans, offline classification, and leaderboard data.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles and defines light/dark eco-themed CSS variables.
Implements mock text and image classification, queues results for backend sync, and returns classification data.
frontend/src/lib/dailyChallenge.ts: Computes daily challenge progress, resetting it if a new day has passed.
frontend/src/lib/errors.ts: Normalizes camera-related errors into user-friendly messages and retry guidance.
frontend/src/lib/imagePreview.ts: Manages creation and cleanup of object URLs for image previews with transfer tracking.
frontend/src/lib/mockClassifier.ts: Provides a mock waste-classification lookup with predefined categories and metadata.
frontend/src/lib/offlineQueue.ts: Stores and manages offline classification events in localStorage with size limits.
frontend/src/lib/share.ts: Shares classification results using the Web Share API or clipboard as fallback.
frontend/src/lib/speechRecognition.ts: Wraps browser speech recognition to start/stop transcription with error handling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with query client and identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: Renders the About page explaining the app’s mission, usage, and features.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Displays the home page with navigation cards for scanning, voice input, and more.
frontend/src/pages/Leaderboard.tsx: Shows leaderboard data with authentication checks, loading states, and rank icons.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Renders the user profile page with authentication checks, profile stats, and daily challenge status handling.
frontend/src/pages/ScanCamera.tsx: Manages camera-based and file-upload scanning, showing previews and running classification before navigating to results.
frontend/src/pages/ScanResults.tsx: Displays classification results, reward points, tips, and lets users share or start a new scan.
frontend/src/pages/VoiceInput.tsx: Handles speech-to-text or manual text input to classify items and route to results.
frontend/src/state/scanSessionStore.ts: Stores, retrieves, and clears the current scan result, managing preview URL lifecycle.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read, persist, and clear URL parameters and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theming, content paths, plugins, and extended colors and styles.
project_state.json: Defines the current project state with existing features and a new request to set the application author name to WAMIQ AHMAD. Contains metadata such as schema version, project info, and feature listings.
